description.value: Kea's Meat & Deli is a specialty butcher shop and deli located on Beresford Street near the Metrotown area of Burnaby. For touring cyclists, it represents a practical provisioning stop where ride food and packaged meats or deli items can potentially be sourced. The shop operates Tuesday through Saturday, making it a useful mid-week or weekend resupply point on routes through the area.
